en: A colorized historic street scene showing a wide avenue lined with multi‑story European-style buildings with balconies and awnings. Horse-drawn carriages and pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing move along tram tracks in the street. Shopfronts with French signage are visible on the right, and the view recedes toward the distant end of the avenue under a clear blue sky. The top left bears printed French text identifying the location as a street in Alexandria.
